view: Assur Qalat Sherqat ancient ziggurat ruin, irregular massive eroded mudbrick mound on high riverbank with low excavated foundations foreground and Tigris bend visible beyond, no complete stepped ziggurat temple or invented towering palace, arid northern Mesopotamia.

eras.title: The mound beside the Tigris
eras.caption: At Assur, the eroded remains of a ziggurat rise above the Tigris-side settlement. Temples, palaces and houses made this both a political centre and the sacred city of the god Ashur, a role that endured beyond its time as an imperial capital.
